name: whisper-medium-sk
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-06-18.
